prompts.spin_arrows: Create one production game UI sprite for Parol Nights, a Filipino Christmas lantern slot. Transparent background with actual alpha. Square canvas. ONLY two thick clockwise curved arrows forming a circular spin/reload ring, symmetrical, front-on, empty transparent center. Luxurious polished deep navy blue enamel arrow faces, thin warm gold bamboo-like bevel rims and tiny cream edge highlights, crisply outlined, warm lantern light, hand-painted glossy 2D mobile game art. Both arrowheads unmistakable, generous open center for a separate star or stop square; no center object, no button disc, no background, no text, no tassels, no sparkles outside the silhouette. Ring centered at canvas center, occupies 60% of canvas width and height, outside 20% padding all sides transparent. Thick readable silhouette at small HUD size. Colors navy #0B1033 and gold #FFC94A, viewed head-on without perspective. This overlays a bright gold glowing circular button so navy faces must dominate for contrast.
prompts.spin_star: Generate one tiny-game-UI center glyph for Parol Nights, Filipino Christmas lantern slot. Actual transparent background, square canvas, one single symmetrical FIVE-point Philippine parol star, red translucent capiz/enamel panels bordered by a simple warm gold bamboo bevel, deep navy clean outline, cream-gold warm center light. Glossy hand-painted 2D mobile game style, front-on and perfectly centered, no perspective, crisp chunky silhouette readable as a star at 20px. No tassels, no hanging loop, no external rays, no glow outside silhouette, no background disc, no circle or arrows, no lettering. Five tips including one pointing straight up. Rich red interior must contrast with a luminous yellow button beneath. Minimal internal gold seams forming five red lantern panels; no fine filigree. Leave transparent padding around the isolated star.
prompts.stop_icon: One production UI STOP glyph for Parol Nights, a Filipino Christmas lantern game. Actual transparent background. One centered square with gently rounded corners, viewed perfectly head-on, flat square silhouette (not a diamond). Thick polished warm gold bamboo bevel border, thin deep navy outer outline, rich dark ruby red capiz/enamel face with a restrained warm glint at upper left. Glossy hand-painted 2D mobile slot art matching traditional parol lantern materials. Interior is simple solid red with very subtle capiz texture, not a lantern star. Must read unmistakably as a solid stop square at 20px, no central hole, no lettering, no pause bars, no circle, no arrows, no button disc, no decoration extending from square, no sparkles, no shadows outside silhouette. Exact 1:1 aspect ratio square object with equal height and width and transparent padding all sides. Navy outline ensures contrast when overlaid on bright gold orb.
